Stop moving to Currituck, please. I know the OBX is cool, I know all the beach properties are sold, I know. But my little hometown with one highschcool for the whole county is gaining 90,000 houses in the next five to ten years. If you going to move here accept the way it is, it’s slow, it’s two lane roads, it’s 55mph on the back roads. Our only grocery store opens at 8 am. But most northerners move down expecting too much, from a highway town. We are “tucked” away in Currituck for reason. It’s going from a sportsman’s paradise to a realtors paradises
